test_cases.name: Verbose quote request for bakery supplies and toys
test_cases.description: A verbose customer from French Bakery requests a quote for several catalog items, providing detailed context and rationale for the selection. The email establishes the business context and item requirements, setting up for a direct order pipeline with order review in the follow-up.

initial_turn.subject: Request for Quote: Bakery Supplies and Toy Selection
initial_turn.body:
Hello,

We are preparing for our upcoming spring event at French Bakery and would like to request a quote for a selection of items that will be used both for our bakery display and as gifts for children attending the event. We have carefully reviewed your catalog and identified several products that fit our needs:

- Pizza (we noticed multiple variants in your catalog, and we are interested in both classic and vegetarian options; please advise on available choices)
- Soda - Medium (for beverage service)
- WonderWagon Pull-Along Train (as a featured toy for our gift bags)
- Organic Carrot (for our bakery recipes)
- Rasta Coffee Beans (for our coffee bar)

If there are any bundle options or volume discounts available for these items, please include those details in the quote. We are aiming to finalize our order as soon as possible, so please let us know if you require any additional information from our side.

Best regards,
French Bakery

test_cases.name: Verbose quote request for multiple catalog items

initial_turn.subject: Request for Quote: Multiple Items for Upcoming Store Promotion
initial_turn.body:
Dear Sales Team,

I hope this message finds you well. I am reaching out on behalf of Super Retail to request a quote for several items that we are planning to feature in our upcoming promotional event. We are aiming to refresh our inventory and would appreciate your assistance in providing pricing and availability details for the following products:

- WonderWagon Bicycle (we are interested in 5 units for our children's section)
- Pizza (please quote for both AITEM-0050 and AITEM-0051, as we are considering offering a variety)
- SmartToys Building Blocks (10 units, as these are consistently popular with our customers)
- Generic Jeans (20 units, for our apparel department)

If there are any special offers or bulk pricing options available, kindly include those details as well. We are looking to finalize our order soon, so a prompt response would be greatly appreciated.

Best regards,
Mario Adams

test_cases.name: Verbose quote request for multiple items with informal tone
test_cases.description: A verbose, informal email from German Bakery requesting a quote for several catalog items, providing extra context and explanations, but not yet triggering any intervention or ambiguity. The email sets up the business context for a direct quote-to-order workflow.

initial_turn.subject: Looking for a quote on a few items for our next event
initial_turn.body:
Hey there,

Hope you’re having a good day! This is German Bakery reaching out—we’re planning for our upcoming summer event and want to get a quote for a few things we’ll need. We’ve worked with you before and always appreciated how smooth the process is, so I’m hoping this will be just as easy.

Here’s what we’re looking for:
- 10 x Pizza (we usually go with the classic, but let us know if you need more details)
- 12 x Soda - Medium (these are always a hit with our team)
- 8 x T-Shirt (we’re thinking of using these for staff uniforms, so if there are color options, please let us know what’s available)

If you need any more info from our side, just ask! We’d like to move quickly on this, so as soon as you can get us a quote, that would be awesome. Also, if there’s anything else you recommend for events like ours, feel free to suggest it.

Best regards,
German Bakery

- 12x T-Shirt (and before you ask, yes, I mean the 'T-Shirt' from your catalog, but I see multiple listings – just quote for the standard T-Shirt you offer, and don't make this complicated)
- 20x Soda - Medium

I expect a prompt response. If you need anything else, ask now, not later. Don't waste my time with unnecessary formalities.

French Cafe

Best regards,
French Cafe
